column1: # unsquad / area88 -- trigger map for the SNES/SFC-soundtrack pack
# (unsquad_snes).  STATUS: SHIPPED-QUALITY -- HARDWARE PASS OK
# (2026-08-31): mapping ear-closed over four review passes + the full-album
# SFC pairing, seams ear-passed after the structure-first loop rework, and
# the staged SD kit tested on the cab.  All 25 in-scope album tracks placed
# (tr27 excluded by decision).
# FINAL LAYOUT (ear-measured).  The driver groups by type, unordered
# within a group; one unused slot sits mid-block:
#   0x00-0x03  CREDIT, SELECT, SHOP, GAME OVER
#   0x04-0x0d  ROUND block: tr04 tr07 tr09 tr26(unused-slot) tr13 tr11
#              tr17 tr18 tr21 tr22   (R1 R2 R3 - R5 R4 R7 R8 R9 R10)
#   0x0e-0x12  BOSS block:  tr08 tr05 tr19 tr12 tr10  (B2 B1 B5 B4 B3)
#   0x13 0x15  ROUND CLEAR, LAST ROUND CLEAR jingles
#   0x14       tr25 LAST RANKING (EAR p4)
#   0x16 0x17  ENDING, SPECIAL ROUND
#   0x18(,1a-1f)  tr16 Cave R6 (EAR p4; identical renders)
#   0x19       tr14 EMERGENCY (confirmed via the 3c_B file)
#   0x20 0x22 0x3a 0x3c  garbage (not music) -- fail open
# BOARD DIALECT (all measured 2026-08-28, MAME 0.288, one boot per probe):
#   * Test mode (DIP "Game Mode", :DSWC mask 128) HALTS the sound driver --
#     injections render digital silence (ffight dialect, NOT sf2/forgottn).
#     Sweeps therefore ran as attract injection with Demo Sounds off
#     (scripted attract injection); silence + positive controls passed at 27 s.
#     Demo SFX are NOT gated by Demo Sounds past ~64 s of attract, so long
#     renders are clean only to ~49 s past injection.
#   * Latch 0x800180, byte duplicated across the word.  Command space:
#     0x00-0x41 base bank; 0x42-0x83 mirrors base (+0x42; proven p50 0.99
#     identical renders); 0x80+ is a separate SFX bank repeating with period
#     0x14; 0xf0-0xff controls.
#   * STOP bytes: 0xf0 0xf1 0xf2 0xfa each kill music from ONE write.
#     sf2's 0xf7 does NOT stop music here (forgottn lesson repeated).  The
#     game itself was seen sending 0xf0 (hard stop before stage music),
#     plus 0xf4/0xf7/0xfb whose effect is not a music stop (unknown control;
#     candidates: sample-channel/duck controls).  Suppression byte for the
#     pack header: 0xf0.
#   * area88 (JP) sweep classifications are IDENTICAL to unsquad (US) for
#     all 256 commands -- one shared pack serves both MRAs.
# EVIDENCE MODEL.  The CMG album's arcade range (tr01-26) is a STUDIO
# RE-RECORDING of the arcade score, not a board line-out: waveform identity
# (tools/xcorr_id.py) fails on certain-true pairs while onset-rhythm periods
# match exactly.  Only the short jingles still correlate.  Every closed row
# below is EAR-CONFIRMED at the listening gate (passes 1-3); ANCHOR/WAVE/RHYTHM notes
# record the pre-ear evidence for the recipe's benefit.
# The snes column composes the cue->arcade-track map with
# manifests/unsquad_album_map.tsv (arcade tr -> SFC tr28-49).  Cues whose
# arcade track has no SFC counterpart FAIL OPEN (verb none, suppress 0).
# tr27 (arrange) is out of scope by decision (2026-08-28).
# SFC-SIDE STATUS: MAPPING FINAL (the full-album pairing pass,
# 2026-08-28).  After the identity passes closed 11 rows, the owner paired the
# remaining arcade tunes to SFC tracks across the whole album -- a mix of
# heard identity and curated role fit (the SFC score is largely original
# mission music, so a strict-identity map would leave most stages on
# arcade FM; the owner's pairing is the map).  SFC tracks may serve
# multiple cues: tr33 BOSS covers both ground bosses (0x0f, 0x11), tr39
# Aviation Division covers Thunder Cloud and Ascending (0x05, 0x0a), tr37
# Ground Carrier/Cave covers Desert and Cave (0x09, 0x18).  0x0e uses
# tr40 per the owner's note ("round 7 ascending boss should be 40") plus the
# earlier tr08==tr40 ear match; the line "8 == 33" read as superseded.
# Unused SFC tracks: tr28 Opening, tr29 Start (SFC-only cinematics).
# Fail-opens (final): 0x00 CREDIT, 0x07 unused slot, 0x19 EMERGENCY,
# and the garbage cues.
